# bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_property (Resource)

Manages a Threat Class Property ETL Filter.

The Threat Class Property ETL Filter object filters Cloud Data Connector (CDC) flow data by threat class or property.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each entry in 'data' must be a valid threat class (e.g. "Malicious", "DDoS") or
# threat property name from Infoblox Threat Intelligence (TIDE).
# The full lists are available from the TIDE API:
#   GET /tide/api/data/threat_classes
#   GET /tide/api/data/properties
resource "bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_property" "example" {
  name = "example_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_property"
  data = ["Malicious"]
}

resource "bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_property" "example_with_optional" {
  name          = "example_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_property_optional"
  data          = ["DDoS", "Whitelist", "Malicious"]
  description   = "Example CDC ETL Threat Class Property filter"
  enabled       = true
  filter_source = "SOURCE_DEFAULT"

  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (List of String) The list of threat classes or threat properties to filter on.
- `name` (String) The name of the Threat Class Property ETL filter.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Threat Class Property ETL filter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Threat Class Property ETL filter is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `filter_source` (String) The source the Threat Class Property ETL filter applies to. Allowed values:
  * _SOURCE_DEFAULT_
  * _SOURCE_INGRESS_

Defaults to _SOURCE_DEFAULT_.
- `ingress_policy_action` (String) The ingress policy action of the Threat Class Property ETL filter.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the Threat Class Property ETL filter.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the Threat Class Property ETL filter, including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
